    try {
        const response = await makeAppScanRequest("/api/v4/AssetGroups");
        const groups = response.Items || response || [];
        if (groups.length === 0) {
            return {
                content: [
                    {
                        type: "text",
                        text: "No asset groups found",
                    },
                ],
            };
        }
        const formattedGroups = groups.map((group) => [
            `Name: ${group.Name || "Unknown"}`,
            `ID: ${group.Id || "Unknown"}`,
            `Description: ${group.Description || "No description"}`,
            "---",
        ].join("\n"));
        return {
            content: [
                {
                    type: "text",
                    text: `Found ${groups.length} asset group(s):\n\n${formattedGroups.join("\n")}`,
                },
            ],
        };
    }
    catch (error) {
        return {
            content: [
                {
                    type: "text",
                    text: `Error fetching asset groups: ${error instanceof Error ? error.message : String(error)}`,
                },
            ],
            isError: true,
        };
    }
});
/**
 * Main function to run the server
 */
async function main() {
    if (APPSCAN_KEY_ID && APPSCAN_KEY_SECRET) {
        console.error("Using direct AppScan API key authentication from environment variables.");
    }
    else {
        console.error("No AppScan credentials found in environment variables. Set APPSCAN_KEY_ID and APPSCAN_KEY_SECRET.");
    }
    registerCreateScanTool(server);
    const transport = new StdioServerTransport();
    await server.connect(transport);
    console.error("AppScan MCP Server running on stdio");
}
main().catch((error) => {
    console.error("Fatal error in main():", error);
    process.exit(1);
});
